subject: Demo window rotation & backfill plan for Nov conference blackout
messages:
From: Amanda Chen <amanda@cloudcommerce.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudCommerce Sales <sales@cloudcommerce.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request to shift our product demo — conference blackout

Hi Dylan,

We realized a couple of our key stakeholders will be at a multi-day conference the week of Nov 27–30 (trade show + customer meetings). We had our Red­wood demo penciled for Nov 28, but that's now a conflict.

Can we move to a date the following week? Preferably Dec 1–3 or the morning of Dec 6. We want to keep the main stakeholders (CTO + Head of Platform) on the call.

Appreciate if you can suggest a couple windows and we’ll confirm.

—Amanda
Amanda Chen
Enterprise Sales Lead, CloudCommerce
amanda@cloudcommerce.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda@cloudcommerce.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to shift our product demo — conference blackout

Thanks for flagging, Amanda — totally understood.

Quick plan from our side: we have several demos scheduled during the week of Nov 27 that overlap with re:Invent and other customer travel. To avoid last-minute churn, I’m proposing a demo-window rotation and backfill approach so we can accommodate CloudCommerce without causing gaps for other prospects.

I’ve attached a proposed-demo-calendar.xlsx with three options (A/B/C):
- Option A: move to Dec 1 at 09:30 PT (preferred — preserves stakeholder availability)
- Option B: Dec 2 at 11:00 PT (fits into EMEA-friendly slot)
- Option C: Dec 6 morning (catch-all if any delays)

Internally I’m looping in Marissa and Ben to handle the swap: Ben will backfill the Nov 28 slot with two discovery calls we can shift from later in the week; Marissa will own the post-demo follow-up materials and capture the eval criteria. Stephanie — can you confirm capacity to support Dec 1/2 as secondary host if needed? Monica, I’ve added a short handoff guide for whoever picks up Nov 28.

Amanda — if any of those three work, reply with your preferred option and I’ll send the updated calendar invite + an updated handoff guide.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://calendar.redwood.ai/dylan

Attachments:
- proposed-demo-calendar.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)
- handoff-guide.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-03T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo window rotation & backfill plan for Nov conference blackout

Putting this into action — I can take ownership of backfilling Nov 28. Plan:
1) Move two low-priority discovery calls currently scheduled on Nov 29 to Nov 28 (10:00 + 15:30 PT) so we have face time with prospects who prefer that week.
2) Reserve Nov 28 14:00–15:00 PT slot for Amanda if we can't get Dec confirmed by EOD Nov 5.
3) Monica — please prepare the pre-demo sheet (key questions + environment checklist) and share with Amanda’s team once Dylan confirms the Dec slot.

Stephanie — I’m marking you as backup for Dec 1/2; if you’re out, Marissa will run the session and I’ll handle follow-ups.

Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Chen <amanda@cloudcommerce.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudCommerce Sales <sales@cloudcommerce.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-07T16:44:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo window rotation & backfill plan for Nov conference blackout

Hey Dylan — thanks for the quick coordination. Option A (Dec 1 at 09:30 PT) works best for us — the CTO confirmed. Please send the updated invite and any pre-demo asks.

Also confirming we don’t need to hold the Nov 28 slot — you can proceed with the backfill. Please include a slide in the demo that highlights fall-off / caching economics — that’s a quick priority ask from our platform team.

See you Dec 1.

—Amanda
Amanda Chen
Enterprise Sales Lead, CloudCommerce
